summary: A reported post-Writhing Coil profession interaction grants the party 3% Versatility for the remainder of the dungeon.
actions: After the Writhing Coil, look for the Unfinished Mixture near the Ascendant Serpent and serpent eggs.
Have a player with at least 25 Midnight Alchemy or Midnight Cooking interact with it.
Treat this record as draft until independently corroborated in game or through another source.

provenance.description: Newly published Wowhead report; retained as draft because it has not yet been independently corroborated by WHELP.
